password.title: Msheireb resident portal
password.description: Use your Msheireb resident portal login.

portal_session.title: Sign in with portal session
portal_session.description: Sign in at https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com in a browser, then copy the whole value of the browser's localStorage key 'msheireb-auth' and paste it here. It contains the refresh token and your contracts. Pasting only the refresh token works only if the contracts can be loaded separately. Treat the token like a password.

reauth_password.title: Re-authenticate Msheireb
reauth_password.description: The saved login stopped working. Sign in again.

reauth_portal_session.title: Re-authenticate with portal session
reauth_portal_session.description: Sign in at https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com in a browser, then copy the whole value of the browser's localStorage key 'msheireb-auth' and paste it here. It contains the refresh token and your contracts. Pasting only the refresh token works only if the contracts can be loaded separately. Treat the token like a password.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. If the password is correct, try the 'Sign in with portal session' option instead.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Msheireb portal.
error.captcha_required: The portal requires a captcha for password login. Go back and use the 'Sign in with portal session' option.
error.invalid_token: No refresh token found in the pasted text.
error.invalid_session: The portal rejected this refresh token. Sign in at the portal again and copy a fresh one.
error.no_contracts: The session is valid but no contracts were found. Paste the whole msheireb-auth value from localStorage instead of only the token.

abort.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different account.

data.pulse_interval: Pulse spacing between Temp Up/Down presses
data.drift_grace: Grace period before acting on an external change
data.adopt_external: Adopt external changes as the new desired state

data_description.scan_interval: How often the portal is polled.
data_description.notifications: Alerts for login, offline and failed commands.
data_description.external_change: What to do when a room is changed outside HA.
data_description.drift_grace: How long a change must persist before acting.
data_description.adopt_external: Keep external changes instead of restoring.
data_description.power_fan_delay: Wait after power changes before the fan press.
data_description.fan_auto_when_off: Off sets fan Auto; on restores the previous speed.
data_description.unlock_enabled: Allow the Unlock door button to open the door.
data_description.power_settle: Wait after a power press before checking it.
data_description.fan_settle: Wait after a fan press before checking it.

error.min_ge_max: Minimum must be lower than maximum.

reauth_required.title: Msheireb login needs attention
reauth_required.description: The saved Msheireb portal login for {title} stopped working and automatic re-login failed. Go to Settings → Devices & services → Msheireb Smart Home and choose Reconfigure/Re-authenticate to enter your password again.
